AMB-0909-CPC-1.summary: Raise the CPC bid ceilings on HVAC Installation ($30 to $65) and HVAC Repair ($25 to $60). AC Repair's $25 ceiling is deliberately left in place.

operations.campaign_name: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Installation | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
operations.current_state: target_spend.cpc_bid_ceiling_micros = 30000000 ($30.00)
operations.reason: Post-keyword-swap window 2026-08-29..09-03 delivered 9 clicks, $425.61, 3 primary conversions, CPA $141.87 against a $280 max CPQL, with a maximum observed CPC of $62.13. The $30 ceiling set on 2026-09-04 took the campaign to 0 clicks in the 4 settled days that followed. $65 preserves every observed converting click with headroom.
operations.modelled_effect: at $60 the settled window retains 98.4% of clicks and 100% of conversions; at $30 it retains 75.8% of clicks and 0% of conversions
operations.rollback: set target_spend.cpc_bid_ceiling_micros back to 30000000
operations.risk: MEDIUM - restores paid delivery and therefore spend
operations.unrelated_resource_assertion: bidding_strategy_type stays TARGET_SPEND; budget, networks, geo, schedule, keywords, negatives and assets are not in the field mask and must be unchanged on readback

operations.campaign_name: Search | NonBrand | HVAC Repair | Central MD | BOFU | 2026-08
operations.current_state: target_spend.cpc_bid_ceiling_micros = 25000000 ($25.00)
operations.reason: Median observed CPC $56.41; Keyword Planner top-of-page LOW for 'hvac repair near me' in the live footprint is $14.87 and HIGH is $97.88. The $25 ceiling retains 24% of clicks. $60 restores roughly half the click volume at a $36.47 blended CPC, inside the optimistic economic band while Quality Score (currently 2, landing-page experience BELOW_AVERAGE) is remediated.
operations.modelled_effect: at $60 the settled window retains 52% of clicks and 26% of spend
operations.rollback: set target_spend.cpc_bid_ceiling_micros back to 25000000
operations.risk: MEDIUM - restores paid delivery and therefore spend
operations.unrelated_resource_assertion: bidding_strategy_type stays TARGET_SPEND; budget, networks, geo, schedule, keywords, negatives and assets are not in the field mask and must be unchanged on readback

notes.ac_repair_deliberately_excluded: AC Repair raw CPA is $616.97 against a $150 max CPQL. No modelled cap makes it profitable: $110 retains 3 of 5 conversions at CPA $298.35, $160 retains all five at CPA $365.82. Raising this ceiling would buy proven-unprofitable traffic, so the campaign is held at $25 pending Quality Score and landing-page work.
notes.who_set_the_current_ceilings: GOOGLE_ADS_WEB_CLIENT on 2026-09-04 16:56 America/New_York (owner, in the UI). Not an agency change.
notes.delivery_impact_measured: 2026-08-14..09-03: $8,025.18, 172 clicks, 14 primary conversions. 2026-09-05..09-08: $45.08, 2 clicks, 0 primary conversions.

notes.why_a_separate_package: Account-level negatives live in a shared_set of type ACCOUNT_LEVEL_NEGATIVE_KEYWORDS. They never appear in campaign_shared_set, the API reports member_count 0 for the set, and a campaign-level removal does NOT override them. AMB-0909-NEG-RM-1 alone will not unblock the manufacturer terms.
notes.dependency: AMB-0909-NEG-RM-1 and AMB-0909-NEG-RM-2 must BOTH be approved for the manufacturer unblock to take effect. Approving only one leaves the block in place at the other layer.
notes.scope_proof: The list applies to all 23 non-removed campaigns. 5 are ENABLED (the five in scope) and 18 are PAUSED and cannot serve, so removal changes live delivery only on the five.
